title: THE COUGH THAT FOLLOWED THE BELLS
author: CLAUDE

rounds.summary: This changes scale and method: a town's children, a preserved bell tradition, medical uncertainty and a hidden airflow path from an old mine. It offers the day's clearest collaborative diagnosis because clinicians, a chimney sweep, the bell ringer and affected families can each hold evidence that the others lack. Illuminara can connect vibration, dust and ventilation without erasing local knowledge or requiring the bells themselves to be destroyed.

First draft of S2 as selected by GPT (B01). Built to answer the selector's stated risks: the diagnosis does not rest on one clue. Illuminara's reframe (address to bed, via Lenka in the mothers' notebook) is checkable in the notebooks; the hour bells ring daily so the cause is one bell on Sundays, not 'the bells'; the sealed-window grant is a second innocent factor, supplied by the sweep; the Wednesday test is built to lose three ways (school counter rises, small bells raise the cellar, no quadrupling within twenty minutes) and separates the Sunday confounds (stoves, baking, crowds) by timing; Hroch's tower-stone rival is answered by a lab result, not by assertion; the sweep's second mouth (street grating) is counted and found to carry about a tenth. Vetoes held: Dana decides whether Old Wenzel is rung and stops on a phone call; Hroch limits access to one course of brick; Rask sets the tenant-consent rule and Fenner's refusal is respected with the cellar left unread; Ilse refuses the word silica until a counter and a lab agree; the mothers decide the cellars are child-free. Illuminara's physical part is bounded: she alone can enter the rotten gallery, sprays eleven of 140 metres, and says the rest remains. Her last contribution is the pressure-pump insight that forces the breather pipe. Costs that remain: Old Wenzel at three-quarter swing until relining, 129 metres untreated, the saint's flour gone, Fenner still unhappy.

The draft has an unusually strong diagnostic engine: Lenka's apparent exception changes the unit of analysis from address to bed; the small-bell control, Old Wenzel exposure, school control and laboratory comparison make a test designed to lose; and the solution remains bounded, consensual and provisional. Dana controls the bell and its stop rule, Hroch controls access, Ilse owns the measurements, Rask protects tenant consent, the mothers move the children, Fenner's refusal is respected, and Illuminara contributes decisive but limited physical work. Before final, the story should tighten three linked proof obligations: connect the measured dust to the cohort's clinical pattern without overclaiming, commission the altered pressure network before children return, and make the temporary eleven-metre treatment auditable while trimming repeated explanation.

Kept: Lenka's exception and the address-to-bed reframe, Nives's notebook, the small-bell control, the school control, the clean-air grating counted at a tenth, Hroch's limestone rival answered by the lab, every veto (Dana's rope and stop, Hroch's one course of brick, Rask's tenant consent, Fenner's refusal, Ilse's refusal of the word silica, the mothers moving the children), Illuminara's bounded eleven of 140 metres, the cost ledger and the closing image of Lenka asleep. Changed: a source-bound cohort check with a disconfirming condition and a committed multi-Sunday follow-up; a pre-occupancy commissioning peal with a numeric stop rule and named owners; a durable rule for the temporary works (inspection cadence, threshold, funding, relining deadline); restated explanation cut from the descent and coda. Three changes are bundled in this revision, so any later difference cannot be attributed to one of them alone.

T03 repairs the draft's three requested weaknesses with unusually economical proof. Nives's cards now bound the clinical claim instead of forcing all forty-one children into one explanation; the changed network receives a pre-occupancy peal with consenting-cellar coverage, a numeric stop rule and named owners; and the temporary works have an inspection cadence, funding, a deadline and a fallback to the small bells. The address-to-bed reframe, Fenner's refusal, Hroch's rival mechanism, Dana's authority and the quiet final image all survive. One final commissioning detail remains load-bearing: Wednesday's harmful count continued rising after the ten-minute peal ended and was reported at minute fourteen, while Saturday's new network is declared safe only from a minute-ten reading. The final must observe the known delayed-arrival window before children return.

Single narrow pass on T04's one priority point. Changed: the pre-occupancy commissioning peal in scene 6 now reads cellars through minute twenty, reports the maximum observed cellar value, applies the forty stop rule at any minute of that window and makes re-occupancy conditional on staying below forty for the complete window. Everything else is byte-identical to T03: the address-to-bed reframe, Nives's cards and the cohort check with its disconfirming condition, Wednesday's controls, the lab result, every veto, the bounded eleven of 140 metres, the governed temporary works, Fenner's self-read unverified cellar and the closing image of Lenka asleep.

A mountain town keeps its school, its bell and its right to dissent because Illuminara changes the question from where children live to where they sleep, then lets a mother's notebooks, a doctor's counters, a sweep's airflow and a ringer's veto prove the cure.
